EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA of the ELITE FOUR.
I've traveled from afar to HOENN so that I may hone my ice skills.
But all I have seen are challenges by weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.
What about you?
It would please me to no end if I could go all out against you!
EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat:
You and your POKéMON… How hot your spirits burn!
The all-consuming heat overwhelms.
It's no surprise that my icy skills failed to harm you.
EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBatt:
Advance to the next room.
And there, confirm the truly fearsome side of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
